panels.title: Estimated reported-token cost/day by tenant (USD) — $100/day reference
panels.description: Estimate only: Hermes-reported tokens are valued at the operator-calibrated blended rate. When coverage is incomplete this is a partial lower-bound estimate; use the coverage panel below.

targets.rawSql: SELECT usage_date::timestamp AS time, company_id::text AS metric, (total_cogs_cents / 100.0)::double precision AS "Estimated reported-token cost/day (USD)" FROM daily_company_usage WHERE company_id <> 0 AND tasks_with_usage_reported > 0 AND total_cogs_cents IS NOT NULL AND $__timeFilter(usage_date::timestamp) ORDER BY 1, 2

panels.title: Estimated cost coverage by tenant/day
panels.description: Completeness denominator for the estimated cost panel. Less than 100% means the displayed estimate is a partial lower bound because one or more AI runs did not report tokens.

targets.rawSql: SELECT usage_date AS "Day", company_id AS "Tenant", tasks_with_usage_reported AS "AI runs with reported tokens", ai_tasks AS "All AI runs", round(100.0 * tasks_with_usage_reported / NULLIF(ai_tasks, 0), 1) AS "Estimated cost coverage (%)" FROM daily_company_usage WHERE company_id <> 0 AND ai_tasks > 0 AND $__timeFilter(usage_date::timestamp) ORDER BY usage_date DESC, company_id
